deduction: The generic binary interfaces do not define one backend-independent interchange format. A file/build compatibility condition is source-based. Curve-specific consequences require original file bytes, real level visitation and caller error/fallback policy.

old_interfaces.dependency: File ABI, endianness, int/unsigned-long sizes and representation must agree with reader.
old_interfaces.format: Three native int fields maxlength,length,sign, followed by length native unsigned-long DigitType digits.
old_interfaces.read_checks: Only a pre-read feof test is shown; fread return counts are not checked by this wrapper.

old_interfaces.header_comment: Records exchange of binary versus text API bodies on9 January1997.

old_interfaces.format: zbfread/zbfwrite store native long words, including signed digit count and payload; limb representation also matters.
